Capture it with your iPhone.
We make it a walkthrough.

Walk the space with the Veylet app on a recent iPhone Pro. Veylet processes and checks the capture automatically, hosts it and hands you a 3D walkthrough to review, usually within 1–2 hours of the upload finishing, with a private link and a website embed. No camera to buy, no course, and nobody sees it before you approve it.

Pilot status. We are onboarding early accounts while our own captures are still under quality review; we have no client-accepted tour to show yet. We confirm the private transfer route; the capture is processed and checked automatically. A capture that is not good enough is never counted.

What counts, and what never costs anything.

An accepted walkthrough
One space, captured with the app, that passed the automatic quality check and that you approved for release. It is the only thing we count.
A whole home
1 walkthrough is one visit to the interior rooms of one home. A home with 5 or more bedrooms, a second dwelling or more than 350 m² of floor area counts as 2. You declare it when you add the listing, and the count locks when capture starts.
6 in your free months
6 accepted walkthroughs across the 3 free months in total, not 6 a month. Use them in one week or spread them out.
2 a month
On the monthly plan, 2 accepted walkthroughs a month, however you are billed. Unused ones roll over, up to 4 banked at any time.
24 a year
On the annual plan, 24 walkthroughs to use any time in the plan year: a yearly pool with no monthly limit. It resets on each plan-year anniversary, and unused ones do not carry into the next year.
4 more, and 4 Super fast renders, for choosing early
Choose annual before your free months end and get 4 bonus walkthroughs and 4 Super fast renders in your first plan year: 28 walkthroughs in total. Once per workspace, however you pay for the plan. Super fast renders are used on this website.
Packs
A pack of 3 walkthroughs is A$169 and a pack of 10 is A$499. The account owner can buy one during the free months or on the plan. Its walkthroughs are used after the ones your free months or plan include, and stay valid 12 months from purchase. Pack walkthroughs are added once payment has settled: by studio invoice today, or by card in your account once card payment opens.
Your first walkthrough
If your first walkthrough isn’t listing-ready, we redo it free. The redo corrects your account’s first accepted walkthrough on the same link and uses no walkthrough; a new capture visit is not included.
A capture that is not good enough
Never counted. The automatic quality check retries once, then asks for a recapture of the rooms it names; that attempt costs nothing.
Seats
Unlimited. Everyone in your office can capture on the same account. You pay for walkthroughs, not people.
Hosting
Every released walkthrough stays live while your account has a running plan: the free months, monthly or annual. When the plan ends, its links, embeds and QR codes keep working for 14 days, then go offline. Restart the plan and the same links come back at once. To keep a single walkthrough online without a plan, ask us for a hosting extension: A$49 a year per walkthrough.
Listing videos and photos
Included in the plan: a landscape listing video, a vertical social video and still photos of each released walkthrough, once video exports open. Files you download are yours to keep.
Starting
Starting needs a payment method on file: Apple’s 3-month free introductory offer in the App Store, a card saved in Square’s card field in your account on this website, or a paid start date agreed in writing for a studio invoice. It provides 3 free months of the Veylet plan with 6 walkthroughs, monthly or annual. During them, nothing is charged unless the account owner buys a pack or a Super fast render. Card payment on this website is coming later. One trial per agency (ABN) and workspace; real captures unlock in the app once the practice room passes.
Before the first charge
The first charge is on the day your free months end, at the price of the plan you chose. Cancel before then and nothing is charged. Your account shows that date and the price. A reminder email 7 days before the first charge is planned but not running yet, so check that date in your account or in your Apple subscription settings.
Stopping
Manage an App Store subscription in Settings › Subscriptions. For an invoiced plan, email the studio to cancel; we confirm the end date. Released walkthroughs stay live for 14 days after the plan ends, then go offline until you restart it, unless you ask us for a hosting extension for a walkthrough.

How it works, start to finish.

Any iPhone 12 Pro or later Pro model, or a recent iPad Pro. One email signs in both the app and your desk on this site.

  1. Walk the space with the phone upright and turn at each spot until the ring closes. The app shows route checks; an automatic quality check assesses capture quality after you send it.

  2. Finish and check the saved route. In the current app, export the capture to Files or AirDrop for the private transfer we arrange; in-app sending is not enabled yet.

  3. Veylet builds the walkthrough and an automatic quality check tests photo match, coverage and walkable paths. It is usually within 1–2 hours of the upload finishing. Not good enough? It retries once, then names the rooms to recapture, and nothing is counted.

  4. Approve the exact version or send one list of corrections; only an approved walkthrough counts. Then copy the link or embed from your desk. Revoking blocks new access immediately.

Apply as a capture partner

Straight answers.

Which phones work?

iPhone 12 Pro and later Pro or Pro Max models, and iPad Pro models with LiDAR, on iOS 17 or later. Standard iPhones without LiDAR are not supported. If you are unsure, tell us the model in your enquiry.

I used my 6 free walkthroughs. Do my free months end?

No. Your free months end on the same date. If you need more before then, the account owner can buy a pack of 3 or 10 walkthroughs: by studio invoice today, or by card in your account once card payment opens. Packs come to the app in a later version. Nothing is added or charged automatically, and your released walkthroughs stay live.

What happens when the 3 free months end?

The plan you chose starts, monthly or annual, and its first charge is on that day. Cancel before then and nothing is charged. In the App Store, the subscription renews automatically at the App Store price unless cancelled through Apple; check the date in Settings › Subscriptions. A card saved in your account on this website is charged on that day unless you cancel first; card payment here is coming later. A studio-invoiced plan starts on the paid start date agreed in writing. A reminder email 7 days before the first charge is planned but not running yet. While the plan runs, every walkthrough you released stays live. If you stop, they stay live for 14 days after the plan ends, then go offline until you restart it; a hosting extension, on request, keeps a single walkthrough online. Your account and records stay yours.

Monthly or annual: which should we choose?

Monthly suits uneven use: A$99 a month for 2 walkthroughs, and unused ones roll over, up to 4 banked. Annual suits a steady year: A$990 a year is 2 months free, and its 24 walkthroughs can be used any time in the plan year, so a busy month can use several. Choose annual before your free months end and you get 4 bonus walkthroughs and 4 Super fast renders in your first plan year, 28 walkthroughs in total.

When does a home count as 2 walkthroughs?

When it has 5 or more bedrooms, a second dwelling or more than 350 m² of floor area. Otherwise 1 walkthrough is one visit to the interior rooms of one home. You declare it when you add the listing, and the count locks when capture starts.

We need more than 2 a month. What then?

Add a walkthrough pack: 3 walkthroughs for A$169 or 10 for A$499, each valid 12 months and used after the ones your plan includes. On the annual plan, the year’s 24 walkthroughs can also go into one busy month. If you expect more than about ten a month, tell us first, and we will say plainly what we can process before you rely on it.

What is a Super fast render?

Your capture goes first in the queue and is rendered on the fastest GPU available in Australia, so it is ready for your review in about 30 minutes, any day, any time, instead of the usual 1–2 hours, for A$29. If it isn’t ready within 30 minutes of the upload finishing, the A$29 is refunded automatically. There is no daily limit: your account offers it when you send a capture. It is sold on this website only, not in the app.

What if our first walkthrough is not good enough to list?

We redo it free. If your first walkthrough isn’t listing-ready, we correct it on the same link, and the redo uses no walkthrough. It covers your account’s first accepted walkthrough; a new capture visit is not included.

Why is the App Store price higher?

The App Store and studio invoice channels have different published prices and payment arrangements. The plan is identical either way, and so is the processing.

What if my capture is not good enough?

The app flags route checks, but these do not prove capture quality. After you send it, an automatic quality check decides: it retries once, then asks for a recapture of the rooms it names; that attempt is not counted. Only a walkthrough you accept counts against your allowance.

Will it appear on realestate.com.au or Domain?

Not yet. REA shows tours only from its supported suppliers, and we are not one. Domain includes its own tour product with some listings. What you get is a link and an embed for your own website, emails, portals that accept a link, and social channels. Tell us the exact destinations you need and we will say plainly which ones work.

Who has to agree to the capture?

Whoever controls the space, and the occupants if it is lived in or worked in. For a rental that means the tenant as well as the owner; for a listing you do not control, the selling agent. Capture permission and permission to publish are separate choices, and the app records both for each space.

Who checks for private details?

You do. Before capture, clear people, documents, screens and personal photographs, and leave out any area you want excluded. Processing is automatic: no one at Veylet views the capture as part of normal processing, and the automatic quality check tests the walkthrough, not privacy. An AI visual check is planned and will be described in the privacy notice before it is switched on. You see the exact version before release; approve it only when nothing private shows. Revocation stops new access at once; it cannot recall copies someone already downloaded.

Who owns the walkthrough?

You keep the rights to your space and its imagery. Your account states who may share, embed and revoke each walkthrough, how long it is hosted and what we retain. We never publish or use your space in our own marketing without a separate written yes.

Can I see a real customer example first?

Not yet. Our captures are still under quality review and we will not show concept artwork as proof. Ask about the current pilot and we will explain exactly what has been tested.
